title: Relative-activity index, leave-one-out minimum

annotations.label: GitHub Copilot generally available to all developers
Stack Overflow moderators begin a strike over AI-content policy

notes: Lower edge of the leave-one-out band around so_relative_index. Relative-activity index, not a causal estimate. Computed from 12-month rolling totals of so_questions_monthly and se_comparison_questions_monthly, labelled by the last month of each window: R = ln(Stack Overflow total) minus the mean of ln(total) across the four primary comparison sites, only for months where all four sites have a full 12 months. Values are expressed relative to the 2019 average (index 2019 = 100), so the pre-AI level is the reference. The companion series so_change_since_chatgpt is measured from the November 2022 window (2022-11). AI also affects the comparison sites, so this is Stack Overflow's activity relative to them, not the absolute AI effect.
